key_management_model: Envelope Encryption with PBKDF2 Master-Derived Keys

lifecycle_stages.derivation: Per-user key derived via PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 128-bit random salt
lifecycle_stages.rotation: Supported via keyVersion tagging ('k1' -> 'k2') with batch re-encryption
lifecycle_stages.revocation: Immediate invalidation upon master key rotation or individual salt deletion
lifecycle_stages.erasure: Cryptographic shredding via Firestore document deletion (removes salt and ciphertext)
